modules.name: imladris-toolchain-bootstrap
build-commands:
cat <<'EOF' > /app/toolchain/bin/imladris-toolchain-check
#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo '=== Imladris Flatpak Toolchain Extension ==='
for cmd in python3 Rscript quarto pandoc uv micromamba pdflatex; do
  if command -v "$cmd" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "  [OK] $cmd -> $(command -v "$cmd")"
  else
    echo "  [--] $cmd (optional/not present in sandbox)"
  fi
done
EOF
